sources.description: According to Luca Evans of The Denver Post, the Denver Broncos are having a pre-draft top-30 visit with Indiana wide receiver Omar Cooper Jr. Cooper Jr. is a talented wide receiver who is rising up draft boards right now and could be in play for the Denver Broncos with their 30th overall selection in the […]
